svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Drawn as a cassette and its J-card. Side A, web app: Nuxt 4 with Vue 3, TypeScript, PrimeVue, Tailwind and Vitest. Side B, API: Laravel 12 on Octane with PHP, PostgreSQL and PostGIS, Redis, queues, Reverb and Pusher, PHPUnit. Runs on Docker, Kubernetes on DigitalOcean, AWS S3 and GitHub Actions. Also React, Next.js and Node.js; exploring Go.
